## Weekly Budget Visualization Plan

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg

Use a **stacked bar chart** to compare how each week’s income is allocated across categories, and a **pie chart** to show the overall spending mix across the month.
This makes it easy to see both week-by-week changes and the dominant expense categories.

## Chart Layout and Key Findings

### 1) Stacked Bar Chart: Weekly Budget Breakdown
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bar-chart-fill.svg

What it should show:
- X-axis: **W1, W2, W3, W4**
- Y-axis: **Amount**
- Stacks: **Housing, Food, Transport, Entertainment, Savings**
- Optional reference line: **Income = 3200** for each week

What to look for:
- Housing is the largest fixed cost every week at **1200**
- Savings varies by week, with the highest in **W2**
- Entertainment is the most flexible category and changes the most visibly

### 2) Pie Chart: Monthly Spending Mix
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/pie-chart-fill.svg

What it should show:
- Use the **sum of each category across all 4 weeks**
- Show slices for:
  - **Housing**
  - **Food**
  - **Transport**
  - **Entertainment**
  - **Savings**

What to look for:
- **Housing** will be the largest slice
- **Savings** will be the next major slice
- **Entertainment** will be the smallest of the spending categories

## Calculation Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Total income per week | 3200 |
| Total savings over 4 weeks | 3740 |
| Average weekly savings | 935 |
| Average weekly savings rate | 29.22% |
| Highest spending category | Housing |

### Savings rate calculation
Formula: **Average weekly savings rate = Average savings ÷ Weekly income × 100**

- Average savings = (900 + 995 + 860 + 985) ÷ 4 = **935**
- Weekly income = **3200**
- Savings rate = 935 ÷ 3200 × 100 = **29.22%**

### Category spending totals across 4 weeks
- **Housing:** 4800
- **Food:** 1670
- **Transport:** 730
- **Entertainment:** 1000
- **Savings:** 3740
